planned_followups.notes: The backend rationalization is now reflected by an initial UI refresh of the 'Workers Edge' tab (summary, workers, and critical flows). Further polish can build on the new structure.
Run a final end-to-end check covering: written question, visible thinking phase, written response, and audio response. The validation harness now lives in scripts/validate_chat_e2e.py.

recent_changes.notes: scripts/run_asr.py now centralizes health payload generation, exposes capture/process loop state, and restarts dead runtime tasks before publishing shared metrics. This prevents the false 'degraded + detail=ready' health state once the worker is restarted.

core/api_impl.py HailoDetector now prefers models/hailo/yolo26n.hef and adds a direct NMS-free decoder for YOLO26 raw outputs (structured boxes/scores/classes or flat rows) while keeping the dedicated detection thread and the >0.6 confidence filter.

tentacles/vision.py now treats YOLO26 as an end-to-end NMS-free model in the active Hailo runtime path. The tentacle auto-prefers models/hailo/yolo26n.hef when present, but keeps the currently working HEF when that artifact is absent so NPU vision stays available.

validate_chat_e2e.py now targets the canonical local API on port 5010. After reloading didier-api and didier-asr, the final written-question -> thinking -> written-response -> audio validation passed against 127.0.0.1:5010.

core/routers/ai.py now uses less aggressive audio queue IPC timeouts (1.2s nominal, 1.0s TENDU, 0.9s SURVIE). This removes false queue_failed results when the audio worker is healthy on the Unix socket.

A restart-ready checkpoint handoff now lives in memory/technical/next-session.md, including the active runtime state, the generated YOLO26 artifacts, the missing-DFC blocker, and the first-step plan for resuming with a compiled yolo26n.hef.

hotspots.issue: still a hotspot; chat/tts/ollama/picobot/routing/coding config access, backend policy, ask-and-speak orchestration, conversation orchestration, input orchestration, Picobot HTTP adapter, and brain IPC adapter are partly extracted into core/ai_config.py, core/ai_backend_policy.py, core/ai_ask_and_speak_service.py, core/ai_conversation_service.py, core/ai_process_service.py, core/ai_coding_service.py, core/picobot_client.py, and core/brain_client.py

stream, detection, and fallback policy mixed in one layer; NPU-required inference is now enforced explicitly, route guards moved into core/vision_route_support.py, passive remote stream status moved into core/vision_remote_status_service.py, vision describe moved into core/vision_describe_service.py, primary detection cache moved into core/vision_primary_service.py, secondary detection state/cache moved into core/vision_secondary_service.py, secondary detection refresh orchestration moved into core/vision_secondary_detection_service.py, and primary/secondary stream routing policy moved into core/vision_stream_service.py, but route I/O is still broad

most major diagnostics logic is now extracted; hardware model selection validation/config mutation moved into core/system_model_selection_service.py, integrations probes/rollup/cache moved into core/system_integrations_service.py, device-status cache/hardware aggregation moved into core/system_device_status_service.py, llmfit report sampling/rollup/cache moved into core/system_llmfit_service.py, camera utility config extraction/control payload shaping moved into core/system_camera_service.py, systemctl/service-state primitives moved into core/system_service_control.py, peripheral inventory/toggle orchestration moved into core/system_peripherals_service.py, workers-edge health probing/payload shaping moved into core/system_workers_service.py, terminal command policy moved into core/system_terminal_service.py; the route is now mostly HTTP wrappers and dependency wiring, with broader diagnostics still concentrated in remaining endpoints
